sources.title: Ars14n/GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-EXL3-3.0bpw · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: EXL3 quantization of dealignai/GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-FP8, itself a weight-edited (no fine-tune) variant of zai-org/GLM-5.3. The edit is documented in CRACK_SURGERY.json (copied unchanged from the source repo). This repo is not affiliated with dealignai or Z.ai.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 Uncensored EXL3 Quant: What It Takes to Run It Locally
sources.snippet: What is the GLM-5.3 Uncensored EXL3 release? It's a quantized version of a weight-edited GLM-5.3, built for people who want to self-host the model without the vendor's safety tuning and without paying for 753 billion parameters at full precision.

sources.title: Unverified uncensored GLM-5.3 EXL3 3.0bpw… · AGI Hunt
sources.snippet: Hugging Face user Infatoshi uploaded a GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-EXL3-3.0bpw quantized model in EXL3 3.0bit format, with a chat template supporting reasoningeffort (defaulting to max) and tool calling. If legitimate, this suggests an uncensored local-quant of Zhipu's next-gen GLM-5.3 is circulating.

sources.title: AIAny - Infatoshi/GLM-5.3-UNCENSORED-EXL3-3.0bpw
sources.snippet: Provides an EXL3 3.0 bits-per-weight quantization of a weight-edited GLM-5.3 UNCENSORED FP8 model for self-hosted text generation and agent workflows. Key characteristics: 753B MoE architecture, 273 GiB on disk, converted with ExLlamaV3; tool-call parsing requires preserving string arguments.
